How it works.

Three small steps. One very plush arrival.

  1. Connect wallet to Robinhood Chain.

    Use a compatible wallet and select Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). Get the chain’s ETH for transaction gas and IMD for the swap. You connect on the launchpad, not on this website.

  2. Find $MUSEGOD.

    Go to SIMD Launchpad (Uniswap v4), search $MUSEGOD. Follow the live Buy link on this site when it becomes available and verify that the contract matches.

  3. Swap IMD for MUSEGOD.

    Review the quoted output, the fixed 2% token buy fee and the separate pool fee before approving a transaction. Feel immediately holier.

Before launch.

The contract reads launching… until deployment metadata arrives. A Buy button without a live trading link leads to the home page guide. Chart links appear only when the launch provides one.

Trading rules.

PoolManager outflows are charged 2%. Pool inputs, including sells and seeding, arrive whole. Fees and slippage affect received amounts; the website does not quote or execute swaps.
